Meta Ad Revenue Surges Past Google Search Amid AI Reshaping

Meta's advertising revenue growth has more than doubled that of Google Search, indicating a significant shift in the online advertising market driven by the integration of artificial intelligence. This development suggests that AI is reshaping how online advertising operates, impacting major players like Google.
